description_en: Queries the branch lineage of an AgenticDB cluster
description_zh: 查询 AgenticDB 分支血缘关系
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-agentic-db-branch-lineage --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id pagc-bp1abcdef1234567 --tenant-id t-4b83e0da66674951 --project-id proj-a1b2c3d4e5f6 --branch-id br-7g8h9i0j1k2l --max-view-depth 3 --include-destroying false --region cn-hangzhou
